description_en: Query nearby locations by latitude and longitude.
description_zh: 通过经纬度查询附近的地点
kebab_example: aliyun iqs nearby-search-nova --keywords '餐厅' --longitude 116.310918 --latitude 39.992873 --radius 3000 --types GAS_STATION_RESTAURANT_HOTEL_ATTRACTION --page 1 --size 5 --city-limit true --sort-rule distance --api-version 2024-07-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: NearbySearchNova

parameters.help_zh: 需要进行语意解析的关键词
parameters.name: keywords

parameters.help_en: Type to which the POI belongs
parameters.name: types

parameters.help_en: Page number of the plugin List. Starting value: 1, default: 1
parameters.help_zh: 插件列表的页码。起始值：1，默认值：1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: Number of entries per page in a paged query. Default Value: 20, minimum: 1, maximum: 50.
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页条数。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：50
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: Restrict Data retrieval to the specified city
parameters.help_zh: 指定城市数据召回限制
parameters.name: city_limit

parameters.help_en: Collation for the Return Result (sort by distance: distance; comprehensive sorting: weight)
parameters.help_zh: 规定返回结果的排序规则(按距离排序：distance；综合排序：weight)
parameters.name: sort_rule
